title: Excalibur | yyzsbackpack Support
body:
This unofficial compatibility pack ensures that the textures in the [yyzsbackpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/yyzsbackpack) Mod seamlessly integrate with the amazing [Excalibur](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur) resource pack.

This pack is currently incomplete and still WIP. For now, I'm not going to do the full [yyzsbackpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/yyzsbackpack) support, just the UI.

**Credits:**

*   [Maffhew](https://www.curseforge.com/members/maffhew/projects) – Creator of Excalibur
*   [yyz729](https://www.curseforge.com/members/yyz729/projects) - Creator of [yyzsbackpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/yyzsbackpack)
